title: Follow-ups from the checkout retry review

drafts.title: Honour retry_after on soft card declines
drafts.body:
## Problem
Soft declines come back with `retry_after`, but `retryCharge` always waits 2 s.

## Proposal
Wait `retry_after` when it's present, 2 s otherwise.

From the review of acme/shop#42.
drafts.why: Agreed in review; nobody owns it yet.

drafts.context: Sam: retry PR is up, would love eyes on it before Friday
drafts.body: Reviewed! Two small comments, nothing blocking. Nice and tight :raised_hands:
drafts.why: A thread reply you'd likely rather post yourself.
